adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` can raise when expected `site_settings` rows are missing: it does `execute("SELECT value FROM site_settings WHERE name = 'uncategorized_category_id'")[0]['value'].to_i` without checking that the query returned any rows, so `[0]` can be `nil` leading to `NoMethodError`. It also derives `category_id` by joining `site_settings.value` to `categories.name` for `embed_category` (`INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name`), so if the category was renamed after the setting was stored, the join returns no rows, `category_id` becomes 0, and it silently falls back to uncategorized, mis-backfilling hosts into the wrong category.
